0.content: Tugarin is Alyosha's black-and-white husky. He has blue eyes and wears a red scarf. Alyosha found him as an abandoned, starving pup and gave him his last two sausages, then walked off, because he could not afford a pet and was hunting a man-eating bear. The pup tracked him to his snow-cave ambush and barked at the bear, spoiling the clean shot. Alyosha fired on instinct and wounded the bear. Tugarin chased it down, and Alyosha found him standing proudly on the carcass. He gave in, said a hunter can't do without a hound, and named the pup Tugarin, hoping he would grow into a real bear-hound.

1.content: Alatyr was a remote Snezhnayan village where aid took days to arrive. In an especially harsh winter, bandits robbed it of the villagers' last Mora and Kristall, and even their sawdust-stretched bread, and tried to burn the houses. Alyosha's parents fought them off with desperate resolve and were badly injured. That night the boy dug out the rifle his father had hidden under the floorboards for his coming of age. He cut ahead of the bandits through the wilds and killed every one of them before dawn. Afterwards he stood frozen among the bodies until noon. The bandits turned out to be penniless.

2.content: The Rokot is a covert Snezhnayan organisation that opposes Project Stuzha and tries to help ordinary people. Members take false identities, usually do not know one another, and choose their own methods as long as they do not use their anonymity to do evil. As Alyosha explained it to the Traveler, it gives the disaffected an outlet and exists in a grey area the Veche could crack down on at any time. Alyosha wrote to the Rokot's president about the Traveler, approval came quickly, and he handed them the application form at the Korolevskiy Theater.

3.content: When the Traveler reached Sretomorozsk in 7.0, every inn was closed, households could not afford heat, and residents were fighting with the Fatui over Kristall quotas. Alyosha suspected the friendly liaison officer Shishkin. With the Traveler and Tugarin he slipped into the station, found an untouched Fatui freight list, and tracked the scent of Kristall to a tunnel at Shishkin's house. He then confronted Shishkin publicly with Polonsky's men. Shishkin claimed it was a one-time theft to save his freezing home village of Alatyr. Alyosha exposed the long-running scheme with the mayor and pointed out that Alatyr has been empty for years.

4.content: Alyosha guided the Traveler into Snezhnograd by train, showed them the city, and took them to Podvorye Restaurant while he fetched his friend Doctor Luneva for Paimon. He spends most of his time in Zolnyy because the rest of the city is "stunningly expensive"; messages reach him through the boss of the Hunter Trade Station there. He also cleans and moves props at the Korolevskiy Theater, where Odette dances and Vodyanitsa sings.
